proof: Admission requires type(diffsh) is exactly LazyDiffVisibility, identity-equal shadow and vegetation leaves, and PackedVisibility-compatible immutable storage.

Dense, duck, subclassed, and different-leaf diffuse inputs return the exact fallback signal and execute the prior independent path.
